exact.R-scape is a method for evaluating covar: R-scape 是一种评估多序列比对中共变的方法，计算时会考虑系统发育背景。它旨在推断统计支持共变碱基对数量最多的二级结构。本页展示对两个结构所做的 R-scape 分析：Rfam 种子比对给出的二级结构，以及一个经 R-scape 优化、带共变信息的新结构。对于二级结构仅为预测、或实验结构支持有限的 RNA 家族，后者尤其有价值。

templates.pat: Welcome to the new Rfam website. We’d love to hear your {{1}} on the updated design and experience.
templates.zh: 欢迎来到新版 Rfam 网站。我们很想听听您对更新后设计与体验的{{1}}。

templates.pat: This website requires cookies and limited processing of personal data in order to function. By using this site you agree to this as outlined in our {{1}} and {{2}}.
templates.zh: 本网站需要使用 Cookie 并有限处理个人数据才能运行。使用本网站即表示您同意这一点，详见我们的{{1}}和{{2}}。

templates.pat: Rfam is part of the ELIXIR infrastructure, and an expert database for {{1}}
templates.zh: Rfam 是 ELIXIR 基础设施的一部分，也是{{1}}的专家数据库

templates.pat: Can't find what you're looking for? Use the AI assistant to ask questions about Rfam data, families, alignments, and more. Click the {{1}} of the page to open the assistant. The assistant is powered by {{2}}, an EMBL-EBI AI service that answers questions from user documentation across EBI resources. For more information on the underlying service, see the {{3}}.
templates.zh: 找不到您需要的内容？可以使用 AI 助手询问有关 Rfam 数据、家族、比对等问题。点击页面右下角的{{1}}打开助手。该助手由{{2}}提供支持，这是 EMBL-EBI 的 AI 服务，可依据各 EBI 资源的用户文档回答问题。有关底层服务的更多信息，请参阅{{3}}。

templates.pat: Our chatbot uses AI to assist you. Its use is subject to the {{1}} and the {{2}}. Do not include any personal information about you or others in the chat (for more information, see the{{3}}).
templates.zh: 我们的聊天机器人使用 AI 为您提供帮助。使用它须遵守{{1}}和{{2}}。请勿在对话中包含您或他人的任何个人信息（更多信息请参阅{{3}}）。

templates.pat: This family is described by the Wikipedia entry {{1}}.
templates.zh: 该家族由维基百科条目{{1}}描述。

templates.pat: This section shows the sequences included in the full alignment for this family. The full alignment contains {{1}} sequences from {{2}} species.
templates.zh: 本节显示该家族全长比对收录的序列。全长比对包含来自 {{2}} 个物种的 {{1}} 条序列。

templates.pat: The seed alignment for {{1}} contains {{2}} sequences.
templates.zh: {{1}} 的种子比对包含 {{2}} 条序列。

templates.pat: We're happy to receive updated seed alignments for new or existing families. {{1}} your new alignment and we'll take a look.
templates.zh: 我们乐于接收针对新家族或现有家族的更新种子比对。{{1}}您的新比对，我们会查看。

templates.pat: The full alignment for {{1}} contains sequences from {{2}} species.
templates.zh: {{1}} 的全长比对包含来自 {{2}} 个物种的序列。

templates.pat: These trees were generated using either a maximum likelihood approach (Rivas & Eddy, 2008) for families with ≤ 64 sequences, or neighbour-joining with F84 distances ({{1}}) for larger families.
templates.zh: 这些树由以下方法生成：序列数 ≤ 64 的家族使用最大似然法（Rivas & Eddy, 2008），更大的家族使用基于 F84 距离的邻接法（{{1}}）。

templates.pat: For sequences which have a structure in the {{1}}, we generate a mapping between EMBL, PDB and Rfam coordinate systems. The table below shows structures on which the {{2}} family has been found.
templates.zh: 对于在{{1}}中有结构的序列，我们会建立 EMBL、PDB 与 Rfam 坐标系之间的映射。下表列出已发现 {{2}} 家族的结构。

templates.pat: Genomic context of this family’s hits in {{1}}, a database of ~131,000 microbial genomes. Neighbouring genes are shown with annotations available on hover. Results are deduplicated to one row per genus. Rfam hits were identified by scanning intergenic regions of SeqHub genomes with nhmmer (E-value ≤ 1e-3).
templates.zh: 该家族命中序列在{{1}}中的基因组上下文。SeqHub 是一个收录约 131,000 个微生物基因组的数据库。相邻基因会显示注释，悬停即可查看。结果按属去重为每属一行。Rfam 命中通过在 SeqHub 基因组基因间区用 nhmmer 扫描得到（E 值 ≤ 1e-3）。

templates.pat: This section shows the detailed information about the Rfam family. We're happy to receive updated or improved alignments for new or existing families. {{1}} your new alignment and we'll take a look.
templates.zh: 本节显示该 Rfam 家族的详细信息。我们乐于接收针对新家族或现有家族的更新或改进比对。{{1}}您的新比对，我们会查看。

templates.pat: Search Rfam families, clans, motifs, genomes, and sequences by keyword, accession, species, author, or other metadata. See the {{1}} for help getting started.
templates.zh: 可按关键词、登录号、物种、作者或其他元数据检索 Rfam 的家族、家族簇、基序、基因组和序列。入门帮助请参阅{{1}}。
